name: 2026-03-28-overnight__hvac_fan
description: [hvac_fan twin of golden '2026-03-28-overnight'; Issue #1193] Door open all day (87F high); 555 min comfort violations; outdoor dropped to 53F overnight
source: Issue #1193: hvac_fan twin of golden '2026-03-28-overnight' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.
notes: This scenario captures natural ventilation cycling from a real activity report (March 28, 2026).
Tests: nat vent pause at 06:00 (directional guard), pause at 14:00 (afternoon peak), re-activation at 20:00, comfort-floor exit at 23:30.
At 06:00: outdoor(75F) >= indoor(74F) — Issue #115 directional guard blocks nat vent; enters paused instead.
At 23:30 indoor drops to comfort_heat=70F — Issue #99 comfort-floor exit fires, heat restores.
The outdoor temp (53F) is still below the nat vent threshold, but the indoor comfort floor takes priority.
06:00 assertion updated for Issue #115: outdoor >= indoor -> paused (directional guard).
Promote to golden/ once all assertions pass in production.

Issue #392: comfort_cool raised from 72 to 76 so the archetype-aware ceiling gate (indoor <= ceiling_threshold, applied to the default/HVAC-fan archetype used here) does not block the 20:00 re-activation (indoor 76F) — this scenario tests directional/threshold/comfort-floor behavior, not the ceiling gate.

hvac_fan twin (Issue #1193): with the HVAC fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air is ventilation (fan on), not a pause. This scenario pins the ventilation/exit/setback decision only; it deliberately does NOT assert the cool setpoint that production also arms during hvac_fan ventilation (nat_vent_ac_assist_armed), which is the rule-3 question tracked in #1142.

Issue #1193 revert-proofing: the 06:00/14:00 assertions were nat_vent_not_active, which reads the final engine state and so passed even with the directional gate removed (and the sensor_open preceded the temp_update, so the gate had no readings). Reordered the events and assert the 'paused' decision instead.

verdict.summary: [hvac_fan twin] Directional guard blocks nat vent when outdoor >= indoor; threshold-based exit and comfort-floor exit still fire correctly
verdict.observed_behavior: paused at 06:00 (outdoor >= indoor), paused at 14:00 (threshold exceeded), nat_vent at 20:00 (cooled below indoor + threshold), nat_vent_comfort_floor_exit at 23:30
verdict.expected_behavior: paused at 06:00 (outdoor >= indoor), paused at 14:00 (threshold exceeded), nat_vent at 20:00 (cooled below indoor + threshold), nat_vent_comfort_floor_exit at 23:30

events.note: morning temps — outdoor 75F >= indoor 74F; new directional guard -> paused, not nat vent
door/window opened, remained open all day (dispatched after the 06:00 temp_update so the directional gate sees outdoor 75F >= indoor 74F)
afternoon peak — outdoor 87F well above threshold 75F, must exit nat vent and pause
evening cooldown — outdoor 74F still below threshold 75F, should re-activate nat vent
midnight — outdoor 53F, well below threshold; nat vent should still be active
